summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue $165 million in bonds for school facility repairs and modernization, repaid through property taxes at an estimated $20 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes $165 million in school bonds and the associated estimated tax rate to fund school improvements.
tax.quote: The proposed school facilities bond, Measure X , would provide locally controlled funding of $165 million to improve and modernize our schools while helping preserve these important community assets for future generations, with an estimated tax rate of $20 per $100,000 of assessed value during the term of the bonds.

schools.text: A Yes vote provides locally controlled funding for improvements and modernization of Liberty Union High School District schools.
schools.quote: The proposed school facilities bond, Measure X , would provide locally controlled funding of $165 million to improve and modernize our schools while helping preserve these important community assets for future generations, with an estimated tax rate of $20 per $100,000 of assessed value during the term of the bonds.
